open_points.subject: configuration-file path reopening during token refresh
open_points.text: “the checks and the read use that one opened file”
open_points.question: Does A16’s per-request change check reopen and resolve the configuration path component by component each time, or keep using a descriptor opened at startup (and therefore ignore pathname or ancestor replacement)?
options: Reopen and resolve every component for every per-request check/read
Keep the startup-opened file descriptor for the process lifetime
Keep directory descriptors but reopen only the final component
open_points.default_guess: Reopen and resolve the complete path for each per-request check/read, using one final descriptor for that check and read.

open_points.subject: location of configuration and credential files relative to the data directory
open_points.text: “These paths lie outside the kernel's private directory”
open_points.question: Is being outside the data directory an enforced installation constraint, or only explanatory threat-model text?
options: Refuse startup when the configuration file or a credential file is inside the data directory
Treat the statement as an installation assumption and perform no containment check
Apply the constraint only to credential files
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as explanatory threat-model text and perform no containment check.

open_points.subject: Linux facility checks at startup
open_points.text: “the kernel neither tests the host nor defines what it does on an unsupported one” contradicts A03 rule 8: “the kernel checks at start ... that `bubblewrap` is present and that one probe execution succeeds”
open_points.question: Must the mandatory sandbox probe still test the effective availability of namespaces and limits, or does the new no-host-testing rule remove or narrow that startup check?
options: Keep the A03 probe; perform no additional Linux-version or individual-facility preflight
Remove the probe because unsupported facilities are never tested
Probe only that `bubblewrap` starts, without requiring the isolation-and-limits probe execution to succeed
open_points.default_guess: Keep the complete A03 startup probe and interpret the new rule as forbidding only separate host-version or facility preflight checks.
